g.text: US-15: Scope Setup - First-Time Operator Configures Workspace
JWT is validated by Express middleware.
user_id is extracted from the token.
Region "France" resolves to a bounding box
from the predefined static region list.
ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET scope = $2, updated_at = now()
SELECT scope FROM user_workspaces WHERE user_id = $1
Scope is loaded into the in-memory
All subsequent alert fan-out for this
